categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Han's CNC Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of PCB (Printed Circuit Board) specialized CNC equipment. Its product portfolio covers key PCB manufacturing processes including lamination, drilling, exposure, forming, and inspection, serving multiple PCB sub-markets such as multilayer boards, HDI boards, IC packaging substrates, flexible boards, and rigid-flex boards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including high-speed precision motion control, precision mechanics, electrical engineering, software algorithms, advanced optical systems, laser applications, image processing, and electronic testing. It develops a comprehensive product matrix spanning mechanical and laser drilling equipment, laser direct imaging, mechanical and laser forming machines, and various electrical and optical inspection devices. Production follows a make-to-order model with modular assembly and rigorous supplier qualification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are PCB manufacturers globally, including over 80% of the top 100 global PCB companies and all companies in the CPCA comprehensive top 100 ranking. End markets served include consumer electronics, automotive electronics, 5G communications, AI servers and infrastructure, aerospace, industrial control, and advanced semiconductor packaging. The company also targets emerging markets such as AI-related high-layer HDI boards and advanced packaging substrates.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant presence in South China, East China, Southwest China, and Northern China regions. It has expanded overseas with subsidiaries in Thailand and Singapore to capture growth in Southeast Asia. Its products are exported to major PCB manufacturing hubs including Europe, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, and Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: Han's CNC operates primarily in the midstream segment of the PCB supply chain, providing specialized manufacturing equipment and integrated processing solutions to PCB fabricators. It also extends support services and collaborates closely with upstream material suppliers and downstream PCB manufacturers to optimize the entire production process.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in automation, intelligent manufacturing, and digital transformation of PCB production. R&D focuses on enhancing drilling efficiency, laser processing technologies, high-precision imaging, and testing equipment to meet evolving PCB complexity driven by AI, 5G, and automotive electronics. It invests heavily in collaborative development with key customers and suppliers to break foreign technology monopolies and expand into advanced packaging markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of specialized PCB manufacturing equipment and integrated one-stop processing solutions to PCB manufacturers. The company also uses agency and distributor channels for certain overseas markets. Additional income streams include after-sales services, maintenance, and value-added lifecycle support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Han's CNC is one of the most comprehensive and leading PCB specialized equipment providers globally, consistently ranked first in the CPCA top 100 for instruments and specialized equipment. It competes with international leaders such as Schmoll (Germany), Mitsubishi Electric (Japan), KLA (USA), and Nidec-Read (Japan) in various product segments. The company emphasizes domestic innovation and import substitution to strengthen its competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.34 billion, representing a 104.56% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 301 million, up 122.20%. Total assets grew 20.19% to RMB 7.19 billion, and net assets increased 9.61% to RMB 5.13 billion. The company maintains a healthy asset-liability ratio of 28.53% and continues to invest significantly in R&D, with expenditures reaching RMB 267 million (7.98% of revenue).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Han's CNC differentiates itself through a broad and deep product matrix covering multiple PCB manufacturing processes and sub-markets, enabling one-stop integrated solutions. Its advanced technologies in laser drilling, high-precision imaging, and automated testing improve production efficiency, quality, and cost-effectiveness for customers. The company emphasizes multi-dimensional collaboration across application scenarios, technology, supply chain, and customer engagement to deliver superior value and foster long-term partnerships.
